data.one_liner: A selection widget with a full-screen modal popup for choosing options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a direct select widget implementation featuring an ethereal, full-screen modal popup that displays available choices when interacted with. It supports custom item builders, item heights, focused item decorations, and options to open on long press for scrollable views.
use_when: You need a custom dropdown or picker UI inspired by specific Dribbble designs
You want a selection widget that displays choices in a full-screen modal popup
avoid_when: You prefer standard platform-native dropdown menus
You are using a version of Flutter older than 3.10
strengths: Clean visual presentation with modal selection popups
Supports customization of item height, focus decorations, and long-press triggers
weaknesses: Limited to specific selection and picker use cases
Requires wrapping content in a DirectSelectContainer
